newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel dispute goes to cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel dispute goes to cabinet.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu called a special cabinet meeting on Tuesday to present a compromise proposal to resolve a dispute over exchange rate policy.

The cabinet was due to convene at 1615 GMT, Netanyahu's office said. There were no details about the prime minister's proposal but a spokeswoman said neither Finance Minister Dan Meridor nor Bank of Israel Governor Jacob Frenkel, who differ over whether the shekel should have a wider trading band than the existing one, had agreed to it.
